user.title: Set up AirSend
user.description:
The `airsend.yaml` file can be present (optional) in `/config`.
The internal URL is auto-detected if the AirSend addon is running.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure AirSend
reconfigure.description: Reload configuration from `airsend.yaml` and update the URL if needed.

pin.title: Secure devices PIN
pin.description: Secure devices ({devices}) will have their radio address and credentials encrypted. Choose a 6-8 digit PIN (no trivial sequences) when creating the vault, or enter the existing PIN. Remove the secrets of these devices from airsend.yaml afterwards.

error.no_devices: No devices found in airsend.yaml. Check the `devices:` section.
error.yaml_not_found: File airsend.yaml not found in /config. Please create it first.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the AirSend addon. Check that the addon is running and the URL is correct.
error.timeout: The AirSend addon is not responding (timeout). Check that the addon is running.
error.no_url: Please enter the internal URL of the AirSend addon.
error.weak_pin: PIN must be 6 to 8 digits and not a trivial sequence (123456, 000000, 121212...).
error.pin_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
error.secure_no_secrets: A secure device has no channel/spurl/apiKey in airsend.yaml and none in the vault yet.

secure_locked.message: {device} is protected: unlock it with the PIN first (lock entity or airsend.secure_* service).

pin_locked.message: Too many failed attempts. Try again in about {minutes} min.

secure_not_sealed.message: {device} has no secrets in the vault. Reconfigure the integration.

not_secure_entity.message: {entity} is not an AirSend secure device.

secure_open.name: Secure open
secure_open.description: Open a secure cover after checking the PIN.

secure_close.name: Secure close
secure_close.description: Close a secure cover after checking the PIN.

secure_stop.name: Secure stop
secure_stop.description: Stop a secure cover after checking the PIN.

pair.title: Connect to the AirSend box
pair.description: Enter the box locator (`spurl`, like `sp://password@[fe80::...]?gw=0&rhost=192.168.x.x`) and choose how to pair.

capture_ready.title: Capture a remote
capture_ready.description: Click Submit, then press ONE button of your remote within {seconds} seconds, close to the AirSend box. Only fixed-code remotes can be captured; for rolling-code remotes use the virtual transmitter mode.

virtual_protocol.title: Choose the radio protocol
virtual_protocol.description: Pick the protocol of your receiver (see the AirSend app or its manual).

virtual_prog.title: Program the receiver
virtual_prog.description:
1. Put the receiver (door/gate/shutter motor) in programming mode as described by its manufacturer.
2. Click Submit: a new virtual transmitter is created and a PROG command is sent.
The door may move.

virtual_confirm.title: Did the receiver acknowledge?
virtual_confirm.description: Most receivers beep, blink or briefly move when they accept a new transmitter.

device.title: Device
device.description: Secure devices have their radio address encrypted and need the PIN to be used.

seal.title: PIN for {device}
seal.description: Create the vault PIN (6-8 digits, no trivial sequence) or enter the existing one.

remove_device.title: Remove a device
remove_device.description: Removes the device and destroys its sealed secrets. Also remove the transmitter from the receiver (UNPROG / receiver memory) to revoke it radio-side.

progress.listen: Listening for a remote... press ONE button now.

error.timeout: The AirSend add-on does not answer.
error.invalid_spurl: The locator (spurl) is rejected by the box.
error.bad_response: Unexpected answer from the add-on (the pairing API may differ on your version).
error.no_frame: No valid radio frame received. Try again closer to the box.
error.multiple_frames: Several different remotes were heard. Retry with only one remote nearby.
error.weak_pin: PIN must be 6 to 8 digits and not a trivial sequence.
error.pin_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.

abort.nothing_to_remove: No natively paired or secure device to remove.
abort.timeout: The AirSend add-on does not answer.
abort.invalid_spurl: The locator (spurl) is rejected by the box.

options.virtual: Create a virtual transmitter (rolling code, recommended for doors)
